wrong_claims: Section 6: 'Users with View All Data or Modify All Data (for example the System Administrator profile) still see the field.' View All Data/Modify All Data do not override FLS, and the System Administrator profile has no FieldPermissions rows on any Storefront__c field; admins see it only via the two permission sets. Test M5 ('without View All Data') repeats the misconception.

defects.defect: States as fact that View All Data / Modify All Data users (System Administrator) see the new formula field without an FLS grant; wrong on the platform and in this org (admin profile has no Storefront__c FieldPermissions rows).
